role: Exploratory anatomical processing of exposed PS13 data; not independent human registration truth
participant: PSBB01, selected before processing as first pinned participant
anatomical_pipeline: Installed FSL BET robust brain extraction, 12-DOF FLIRT MRI-to-MNI initialization, FNIRT T1-to-MNI default 2mm configuration; inverse warp Harvard-Oxford cortical maxprob threshold25 atlas to subject MRI
PET_pipeline: Duration-weighted 20–90 minute PET mean; independent FSL FLIRT 6-DOF normalized mutual information PET-to-MRI; propagate supplied atlas labels with nearest-neighbor interpolation
regions: All nonzero Harvard-Oxford cortical atlas labels; no PET intensity threshold ROI
outcomes: Region volumes, anatomical QC overlays, regional TACs and fits with all failures retained
limits: Atlas labels are estimated from registration, not individual ground truth
PET motion correction not added in this exploratory comparison
No qualification gate is passed from successful execution or visual similarity
